title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M2 is SCOPED AND DESIGNED but NOT implemented - no code, test or config changed this session and the tree is clean. main re-derived at 1bb149d (PR #22 squash), green 1766/0 by orchestrator execution, merged M1 branch deleted. Work is now a five-PR sequence that must ALL land before M3 per 0156: P1 mirror-census closure, P2 MSP M2, then P3-P5 conditional extractions. P1 and P2 are implementation-ready; no further research is owed for them.
spine.next_step: READ docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-31-m2-mirror-gaps.md FIRST - 37KB, gitignored, machine-local, the orchestrator never read it, and its re-derived anchors WIN over any summary. Then settle two rulings: is H-C (journal shipped unioning into done at mitosis.js:4058-4061) in M2 or deferred, and track the plan or accept it machine-local. Then implement P1 (census closure, zero production change), then P2 (M2). Every PR owes a 12-id coverage entry.
open_risks: msp-file-scope.mjs is a LIVE unpoliced twin, verified independently by the orchestrator: aggregateMspFileScope is duplicated at mitosis.js:67-78 and absent from mirror-guard.test.mjs:19 (grep count 0). Edit either copy and nothing detects drift. P1 fixes it.

The mirror guard's WHOLE-FILE granularity HIDES partial twins: pr-format.mjs (PR_TITLE_TYPES/PATTERN/VALUE_CAP), wave-planner.mjs (pathsOverlap/scopesOverlap), engine-args.mjs. A file-granular census would pass while real duplication drifted; the census must work at EXPORT granularity.

Implementing spec 3.1 LITERALLY is a SAFETY REGRESSION - a total fact-assign resurrects condemned content because a ref means a commit exists, not that it is shippable; frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. gh pr list --limit 200 means absence is not evidence of non-merge. See 0154.

The orchestrator has NOT read the 37KB plan - only the audit's summary plus facts it verified itself. On ANY conflict the plan's own re-derived anchors win; surface the discrepancy rather than smooth it over.

docs/superpowers/plans/ is gitignored (.gitignore:22), so the plan is machine-local and invisible to a clean checkout and to CI. Third instance of this repo's ignore rules swallowing real work. Ruling owed: track it or accept machine-local.

H-C is UNRESOLVED: journal shipped unioning into done at mitosis.js:4058-4061. The recommended approach edits two reader sites, covering H-A (the 3787 veto) and H-B (selectResumeBuilt) only. Rule H-C in or out of M2 BEFORE implementing.

P3-P5 are explicitly CONDITIONAL - re-confirm the justifying milestone still names the region before opening each. If M3 deletes runReconcileOnlyAdvance outright rather than absorbing it, P4 would extract code only to delete it.
M3's 'shepherd path' wording has TWO candidate referents; settle it before planning M3. Blocks M3 and the P4/P5 justification only - nothing earlier.
Spec anchors pin to 450804e and run +68 to +81 off against main, which has moved again. Re-derive by execution; NEVER copy a spec line number (0148). Held for every M2 anchor this session.

0152 generalized: treat EVERY enumeration and every absolute claim in the quiescent-advance spec as UNVERIFIED until executed. Four more defects found this session. Section 8's 22-to-14 arithmetic is still NOT re-derived.

Section 10's mirror-twin gotcha list is WRONG for a third consecutive MSP, and M2 is the first with TWO policed twins in scope (parking.mjs, run-log.mjs). Grep every target symbol against mirror-guard.test.mjs:19 per MSP; the guard asserts whole-file containment.

Every PR needs a docs/invariants/coverage/*.json entry verdicting ALL 12 registry ids, ADDED in that PR's own diff. The gate reads COMMITTED history, not the index. Piping the gate to tail MASKS its exit code - capture it directly.
The coverage gate checks row SHAPE, never the truth of a check string, so the entry stays orchestrator-authored per 0143.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL AGENTS; compileUnderSandbox discards it deliberately. No test may call it.
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval, and every extraction PR edits those trees. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.

The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (1766 tests). ALWAYS redirect and read only the tail, and match the node reporter's info-prefixed summary lines, not the TAP form. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.

A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; post-creation title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141). Titles cap at 72 chars. Merge stays human-gated.
Verdict truthfulness stays a HUMAN/orchestrator gate (0143). Held this session: the orchestrator verified the unpoliced twin and the green baseline itself rather than relaying agent numbers.

ALWAYS_DENIED's pinned realm surface runs in CI on every push and PR while node-version floats at 26.x, so a Node minor adding a global halts the gate. Fail-closed by design (0140); classify the name, do NOT pin Node.

12 leaked worktrees / ~78MB remain live and the reaper verb does not exist. The tree carries pre-existing dirt (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, three untracked paths) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.
out_of_scope: Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
